title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling samples, and docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to help developers onboard faster and demonstrate recommended patterns for production. This PR adds curated templates, runnable examples in redwood-examples, and doc site content (tutorial + reference) with code snippets for Python and TypeScript. The change also harmonizes agent configuration keys and documents recommended KV-caching and prompt templates.

What changed (summary): added three quickstart recipes (basic RAG agent, multi-tool agent, conversational RAG with state), added two tool-calling samples showing fetcher + retriever wiring, added multiple docs site pages and sidebar entries, updated redwood-examples with working demo and CI test, and small API docs clarifications. Included unit tests for example runners and smoke tests for docs examples.

Notes: kept all examples intentionally small (~10-20 lines) and included run instructions using local dev server and the hosted API. Where appropriate, linked to internal evaluation guides and to the agent template registry.

Checklist:
- [x] Add quickstarts and runnable examples
- [x] Docs site pages + sidebar updates
- [x] Tests for example runners
- [x] CI docs build green
- [x] Address reviewer feedback and lint warnings

Related: ENG-4521 (RAG quickstart), PM-118 (developer onboarding), previous docs PRs that added agent templates.
